# nomatron_variable (Resource)

Nomatron variable resource supporting global, organization, application, and job scopes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nomatron_variable" "example" {
  scope     = "job"
  org_name  = "platform"
  app_slug  = "payments"
  job_slug  = "web"
  key       = "db_password"
  sensitive = true
  value_wo  = "super-secret-password"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Variable key.
- `scope` (String) Variable scope. One of `global`, `organization`, `app`, or `job`.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `app_slug` (String) Application slug for app or job scoped variables.
- `description` (String) Optional variable description.
- `job_slug` (String) Job slug for job scoped variables.
- `org_name` (String) Organization name for organization, app, or job scoped variables.
- `sensitive` (Boolean) Whether the variable value is sensitive.
- `value` (String) Stored default value for non-sensitive variables.
- `value_type` (String) Variable value type. One of `string`, `number`, `bool`, or `json`.
- `value_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only default value for sensitive variables.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the variable was created.
- `id` (String) Variable ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the variable was last updated.
- `value_id` (String) Default value row ID, when present.
